trust_decision.summary: Whether the phar:// stream wrapper is available to a PHP process. At the pinned commit it is removed only inside the AppModel constructor, which runs after the Cake bootstrap has already included the (possibly relocated) app's Config files and only when a model is built. The fix removes it at the top of both front controllers, before anything else runs.

landing_point.why: Grepping 'phar' leads to the per-setting 'Phar protocol not allowed' prefix checks in the Server setting validators (also :2145), and to the existing unregister in app/Model/AppModel.php:155. Neither is the front-controller site the fix uses.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP request (web front controller; app/index.php:17 requires it)
the `app/Console/cake` CLI (app/Console/cake:31), including background workers started via app/Lib/Tools/BackgroundJobs/BackgroundJob.php:81

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/Console/cake.php:20 (the CLI bootstrap reached through the shell wrapper app/Console/cake:31 and by background jobs at app/Lib/Tools/BackgroundJobs/BackgroundJob.php:81). The relocated-app-root chain (-app/-working switches) runs here, before any model exists: see app/Lib/Tools/BackgroundJobsTool.php:89-96.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The parent commit already blocks console path switches in job arguments (app/Lib/Tools/BackgroundJobsTool.php:97-102), and AppModel already unregisters phar (app/Model/AppModel.php:155), so a solver can argue that the CLI is covered and only harden the web side or the setting validators.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Writable-directory settings legitimately accept the s3:// stream wrapper. An over-broad fix that rejects every '://' in path validators, or unregisters every non-file wrapper, breaks S3 storage paths.

O6_input_shapes: phar:// path reaching any filesystem call during an HTTP request
phar:// path reaching the CLI bootstrap through a relocated -app/-working root, before any model is constructed
any case variant of the scheme (e.g. PHAR://): handled implicitly because the wrapper is unregistered rather than string-matched

O7_producer.where: Cake bootstrap include of the app's Config (app/webroot/index.php:84-91; CLI via app/Console/cake.php:42-47 -> ShellDispatcher path parsing, referenced at app/Lib/Tools/BackgroundJobsTool.php:89-96)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Standalone LdapAuth test script includes Config/config.php without going through either front controller, so phar stays registered
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Operator-run diagnostic script that takes no caller-influenced path; not a web or console entry point
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: plugin package, 5 directories from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Case-sensitive 'phar://' prefix check; PHP resolves wrapper names case-insensitively, so a case or alias differential is realistic here
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same substr(...,0,7)==='phar://' idiom is copy-pasted across validators (also :2145); a maintainer adding another path setting would copy it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second standalone PHP worker script run via ProcessTool that does a filesystem call on a caller-supplied path, without the front-controller unregister
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MISP already runs this standalone script from app/Model/Server.php:4750; a helper script that bypasses the Cake bootstrap is a plausible maintainer addition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Existing regex stripping of phar:// from a URL; a deny-list sibling in another plugin is realistic
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Shows that the project already defends with per-caller string filters in plugins

O9_family: deserialization via phar stream wrapper (CWE-502 / CWE-74), process-level hardening at bootstrap

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 7.4/8.x CLI, composer (app/composer.json), phpunit; vendored CakePHP 2 git submodule app/Lib/cakephp (not checked out in the screen tree)
O10_build.project_tests: Standalone phpunit tests under app/Test with stubbed App::uses (e.g. app/Test/BackgroundJobsToolArgumentsTest.php:1-40); nothing exercises the front controllers

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make the Server.php 'phar://' prefix checks case-insensitive or add more per-path filters, or move the unregister into AppController/AppModel. Both leave the CLI bootstrap open, because the include happens before any model or controller exists.

out_of_scope_notes: app/webroot/index.php:96-102 duplicates the polyfill require block (harmless).
